name: Haruna Ryou
source:
Haruna Ryou is a serious soldier. He’s had 7 decorated years within the army and a very successful career within the special forces. However, perhaps because of the time he spent in battle, he’s quite emotionless, never letting emotions get in the way of method.

[From [url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2009/12/28/review-eden-they-were-only-two-on-the-planet/]Choux's review[/url].]
